title: Embedded Software Development Engineer-IV
excerpt: Job Profile: Embedded Software Development Engineer-IV Location: Noida Sector 125 Experience- 7 Yrs or Above Do you want to be a part of enabling the next wave of innovation in communication protocols, building sensors and cutting-edge hardware? Does working with IoT devices, sensors, wearables, controllers which can seamlessly merge the digital world with the physical […]
whoWeAre: We are Probus Smart Things and are working on IoT solutions that can be used to solve massive scale problems by connecting things to people.
At Probus we are digitizing the electricity distribution grids to bring down network losses and ensure that electricity reaches every household.
We do this by building sensors, controllers, low power edge devices, connect and manage multiple sensors with our ecosystem.
Probus Smart Things has been awarded as the Startup of the Year 2018 and our wireless technology in 2020, has been awarded by India Smart Grid Forum, Government of India.
Probus has also been mentored by Cisco and Qualcomm in their startup accelerators.
We are a Venture Capital funded company and have raised our pre-series-A round in 2021.

We are looking for passionate engineers and professionals to build the hardware and software that runs on edge computing, system on chips, communicates with cloud servers, server-less containers, and everything in between.
we: Are a team of technologists from diverse backgrounds
Obsess over design and product journey
Obsess over our customer’s needs and experience
Are owners. We love building new innovative technologies, and improving our existing ones
Wear multiple hats. We enjoy the prototyping and tinkering stages, as well as the rigor of making solutions production-ready.
Are fast-growing, agile and collaborative
you: Enjoy seeing the impact your work has on real customers
Enjoy being a part of a creation that can shape the future of the world as we know it
Enjoy working with the cofounders and the founding team of a growing startup
Are comfortable in an agile environment and create order from ambiguity
Are excited about the incredible opportunity connected products represent
Build strong teams with others as passionate as you about this mission
Take ownership and doing whatever it takes to get the job done
Want to create applications at a massive scale used by millions of people
Use data to make decisions and validate assumptions
Learn from others and help grow those in your team to achieve their best

culture.title: Trust
culture.description: We trust our team to the core in all their actions they perform in day-to-day work.

culture.title: Clear Communication
culture.description: We are direct and succinct. We share information efficiently, improving collaboration and productivity. We practice active listening.

culture.title: Efficient execution
culture.description: We have a bias for action. We complete high quality work quickly. We focus on the 20% of work that will get us 80% of the impact.

culture.title: Act like an owner
culture.description: We take 100% responsibility for achieving the mission. We seek to improve all aspects of our company even in ways that are not explicitly part of our job.

culture.title: Continuous learning
culture.description: We’re humble, and value learning over being right. We embrace delivering and receiving candid feedback, and see every setback as an opportunity to learn.

culture.title: Championship team
culture.description: We are a winning team, not a family, and have high expectations for performance and delivering results. We’re stronger together so we choose to focus on what unites us, and not on what divides us.

responsibilities: You would be working on product lifecycle, enabling the hardware to work as per its designed parameters, work on circuits, various processors, controllers, sensors, algorithms and communication protocols, including algorithm design and protocol testing and debugging to make it production ready.
Develop and maintain firmware for embedded systems, focusing on basic level data structures.
Utilize IDEs such as STM32, Eclipse, and KEIL for firmware development.
Have a strong understanding of version control systems (VCS) for efficient collaboration and code management.
Work with E Linux environments, ensuring seamless integration and functionality.
Optionally, contribute to projects involving real-time operating systems (RTOS) and baremetal programming.
Optional proficiency in Python and shell scripting for automation and scripting tasks.
You would directly contribute to and influence the ultimate client outcomes we care so much about.
Your development work will allow business assets (engines, factory equipment, trains, etc.), sensors, platforms, applications, and more to communicate with one another and drive action.
qualifications: Bachelor/Postgraduate in Electronics and Communication Engineering(ECE).
Work experience of 7 years or above in Embedded software development.
Language – Embedded C, Embedded C++.
Python, shell scripting is optional.
Experience in metering and energy products
Extensive knowledge of MQTT, DLMS, MODBUS, RS232/485, IEC104/850 protocols, Embedded Linux.
Extensive experience working with ARM application processors.
Knowledge of BLE5.0 and WiFi protocols.
Knowledge of debugging of hardware.
Knowledge of RF(2.4 Ghz, 4G/LTE, and Sub-1 Ghz).
Capacity to work dedicatedly towards goal achievement
Familiarity with version control systems (e.g., Git, SVN).
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills
Clear electronics basics
